task: Comparative evaluation of Temporal World Model vs Logistic Regression vs Persistence

scientific_interpretation.persistence: Persistence Baseline achieves F1 of 0.9524 with 0% FPR because traffic state transitions have temporal continuity in short horizons.
scientific_interpretation.world_model: World Model achieves 100% attack recall (11/11 attack states detected in advance) with F1 of 0.7857 and ROC-AUC of 0.6667, providing early trajectory modeling and continuous forward simulation.
scientific_interpretation.logistic_regression: Static Logistic Regression achieves F1 of 0.8148, but its ROC-AUC is lower (0.2121) due to lack of temporal sequence memory across historical windows.
